summary: Wide gravel verge beside Bowhill Road, paddocks behind, no homes close.
reasons: Nearest home about 50 m, across road

best_section.where: Gravel and dirt verge on the north side, 20 to 40 m west of the gated track mouth

drivers.seclusion: Paddock to the north; the nearest house is across a main road and a yard, 50 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel verge meets the road edge and is wider than a van; tyre tracks show vehicles pull in.
drivers.traffic: Fast, busy two-lane road beside it, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Tyre tracks and a worn pull-off suggest regular informal stopping.

flags: Keep clear of the apron in front of the gated powerline track to the north-east
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Blunder Creek 59 m away, flood-prone
Road noise from a busy arterial
sun_shade: Open to the sun; a few trees shade the verge from the west in the afternoon.
